arguments.text: 8000 m race, 1250 m out-and-back legs. Pacer owns effort. My job: (1) watch instrument health - pod vs boat-model power ratio and heart rate vs pod power (pod drift -> set pod_gain); (2) weed/drag - push_local drops within a leg (pacer clears rudder; I confirm with GPS dip); (3) current/wind changes; (4) radio course changes -> set_race_distance + tell; (5) paddler talk. Baseline: settle-phase ratio boat_power/shaft_power about 0.70-0.72; HR at ~CP effort. Wake every few min; keep cues few.

t=60s start: shaft 235 W (CP shaft 199), boat-model 170 W (CP 139), ratio ~0.72; HR 156 rising; leg1 heading N, push_along -0.32 (against). Need settled baselines at ~4-6 min: boat/shaft ratio, eta_est, HR vs shaft power.
